about: The licence table the conformance kit (tests/conformance/kit.py, G8) reads offline against tools/data/extra_closures.json. A package passes only when every licence source it carries is allowed here; a banned name or licence fails, and so does anything this table cannot place (unknown fails). Edit it only with a reason, and cite the source for an override.

banned_packages.coqui-tts: Coqui TTS: its models are under the non-commercial Coqui Public Model License (DoD G8)
banned_packages.fitz: the import name of PyMuPDF, which is AGPL (DoD G8)
banned_packages.litellm: model calls go through g6.core.llm alone (DoD G6, G8)
banned_packages.tts: Coqui TTS: its models are under the non-commercial Coqui Public Model License (DoD G8)

rulings.MPL-2.0: allowed: file-level copyleft that binds only changes to the MPL files themselves; G6 installs these packages unmodified and vendors none (certifi, hypothesis, tqdm on 2026-10-20)
rulings.LGPL: fails unless the owner rules on a named package, and then only in the closures that ruling names: the owner's ban covers 'any GPL'; on 2026-10-22 the owner allowed cons (LGPL-3.0) in the bayes extra only
rulings.BSD: the generic 'BSD License' classifier: every BSD variant is permissive
rulings.TCL: allowed: the Tcl/Tk licence grants use, copying, modification, distribution and licensing for any purpose, keeping the copyright notices, with no copyleft (ujson's numeric decoder carries it; the LICENSE.txt in the ujson 5.12.0 wheel, read 2026-10-21)
rulings.conflicting metadata: when a package's licence field and its classifiers disagree (nvidia-nvtx says Apache 2.0 and Other/Proprietary), every source must be allowed, so it fails

cons.source: its PyPI metadata names no licence; the LICENSE.txt the cons 0.4.7 wheel carries (licenses/LICENSE.txt in its dist-info, read 2026-10-22) is the GNU Lesser General Public License, Version 3
cons.owner_ruling: owner, 2026-10-22: allow cons, PyTensor's dependency through PyMC, installed unmodified by pip only with the opt-in bayes extra, never vendored and never in all

fast-plaid.source: its PyPI metadata names no licence; the LICENSE file the fast-plaid 1.4.6.2110 wheel carries (licenses/LICENSE in its dist-info, read 2026-10-21) is the MIT License, Copyright (c) 2025 LightOn

fsspec.source: PyPI's JSON for 2026.7.0 names no licence; that wheel's METADATA says License-Expression: BSD-3-Clause and its licenses/LICENSE (read 2026-10-21) is the BSD 3-Clause License, Copyright (c) 2018, Martin Durant

lupa.source: PyPI says only 'MIT style'; LICENSE.txt at github.com/scoder/lupa (read 2026-10-20) is the MIT permission notice

minikanren.source: its PyPI metadata names no licence; the LICENSE.txt the minikanren 1.0.5 wheel carries (licenses/LICENSE.txt in its dist-info, read 2026-10-22) is the three-clause BSD licence, Copyright (c) 2019 Brandon T. Willard and (c) 2012 Matthew Rocklin

smolagents.source: its metadata names no licence; the LICENSE file the smolagents 1.26.0 wheel carries (licenses/LICENSE in its dist-info, read 2026-10-21) is the Apache License, Version 2.0
